messages:
jia: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's latency/throughput incident. Recurring pattern at ~03:30 UTC — cache warmup + imbalance across zones. Need owners for remediation and SLO updates. Proposal: keep p50 40ms, tighten p95 280ms -> 180ms, keep p99 800ms. For throughput SLO, raise steady-state target from 95rps -> 110rps after autoscaler fixes. Also bump early error-budget alarm to 1% burn in 15m to page oncall. Claim one of: (A) SLO + customer migration notes, (B) dashboards & alerts, (C) runbook + triage playbook, (D) autoscaler/routing fixes. Please claim by EOD PST.

leo: I'll take (A). Will draft SLO change and a short customer-facing note explaining semantics. Target PR by Fri. Question: do we stage p95 change in canary region first?

jia: Yes, canary region first. We'll monitor fallback triggers. Keep p99 unchanged for now.

marta: I'll grab (B). Plan: add regional p95 heatmap, a throughput capacity panel, and an alert: `error_budget_burn_percent > 1.0 for 15m` -> page eng-oncall. Also add a small widget that shows fallback activations and their latencies.

samir: I'll own (D). Investigate autoscaler thresholds and routing imbalance. Plan: reduce scale-up cool-down, add weight rebalancer across zones, and metric for imbalance_count. Will run a small loadtest after changes.

leo: I'll include migration notes for Dedicated customers and an internal FAQ about SLO evaluation windows.

oncall-bot: IncidentBot: postmortem draft created at 2192000120 -> https://infra/reports/2192000000

marta: Dashboard queries (examples):\n- p95 by region: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, region))`\n- throughput: `sum(rate(requests_total[1m]))`\nWill stage panels in dash-staging and post link.

samir: Filing RFC for autoscaler changes and will include rollback steps. ETA for RFC review: Wed.

jia: Assigning action tracker items: - leo: SLO PR + migration note  due 2026-03-31 - marta: dashboards + alert rules  due 2026-03-27 - samir: autoscaler/routing fixes + tests  due 2026-03-29 We'll run a coordinated smoke test after all changes and review at next SLO sync. Thanks.

leo: Noted. I'll open the PR as draft and add canary rollout instructions.

marta: Staging dash ETA Tue. Will ping when up.

samir: Will link loadtest results here once done.
